hook: Army training truck hits tree in Chevella, *8* hurt
hook_b: Army training truck hits tree in Chevella, *8* hurt
tldr: An Army truck carrying 14 personnel hit the median at Allawada, Chevella on Friday morning, went out of control and rammed a roadside tree.

beats.what: Eight personnel suffered minor injuries and were taken to the Army hospital in Golconda, Chevella ACP B Kishan said, per TOI.
beats.why: Police say the truck hit the median while a trainee was driving, then lost control.
beats.care: Chevella-Shabad road users: police say no case has been registered and no complaint given so far.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The truck left the Golconda Army camp for Shabad at around 6.30 am.

cards.q: Where should driver training runs happen?

qs: Do military driver-training runs need civilian road safety checks?

facts.t: The truck carried *14* personnel on a driver-training run, police said.

viz.l: Personnel hurt out of 14 on board
viz.verdict: Minor injuries, all treated at Army hospital

steps.e: Truck leaves Golconda camp for Shabad

watch: Whether a case is registered or the Army orders an inquiry.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Hyderabad: 8 Army personnel injured after truck crashes into roadside tree

fact: Army training truck rams tree near Chevella; *8 of 14* personnel hurt.
twist: A trainee was driving: the truck was on a driver-training run from Golconda camp to Shabad.
